annotation_method: Assistant-authored from captions; not human-approved ground truth yet. No image or linked-page interpretation.
holdout_policy: Three per channel. No pilot captions or expected answers are prompt examples. Freeze the initial prompt/schema before scoring. Infrastructure fixes do not tune semantic instructions. If held-out errors inform prompt changes, report later runs as re-evaluation.
semantic_comparison_rules: Compare benefits, terms and effective location schedules, not title wording, IDs or array order.
Equivalent redundant range boundaries around an unchanged exact-date set are acceptable; date gaps must remain excluded.
Missing dates are null. A date-status review flag is not equivalent to an unspecified schedule.
Preserve full source links; never follow them to add extraction facts.
Record every missing or extra offer/location and classification/date/restriction/review error. Manual corrections must not change the scored model output.
